universities.name: TAFE NSW
universities.aboutHtml:
Technical and Further Education (TAFE) NSW plays a vital role in training the workforce of the future. As they continue to innovate, and respond to changing community and industry skills needs, TAFE NSW are writing the next chapter of the proud 130-year history of an organisation with roots embedded in Australia’s heritage.

Sydney Technical College opened in Newcastle in 1835. In 1883, the NSW State Government assumed responsibility for Sydney Technical College. This date is often quoted as the year that TAFE NSW, although not yet known by this name, was born.

During the 1970s, the establishment of the Technical and Further Education Commission (TAFEC) and the provision of Commonwealth funding had a historic effect. Technical education would now be known by a new name – TAFE – and be recognised as a distinct educational body with its own administrative structure. A policy of regionalisation was brought into play with community colleges further expanding across NSW to meet training needs. In 2017, TAFE NSW returned to a more centralised model, bringing together 130 campuses across the state, allowing them to get better results for students and employers, and to continue TAFE NSW’s proud tradition delivering the highest quality education and training.

Today, TAFE NSW is the leading provider of education and training in Australia, with industry qualified and experienced staff that bring up-to-date real-world skills directly to the classroom. They have over 130 years of history, and their courses and facilities are internationally-renowned.

TAFE NSW’s courses and degrees can help put students on the path to where they want to be. With over 25,000 employer connections, graduates can be assured that their qualifications are well regarded.

TAFE NSW has over 130 locations in New South Wales and a wide variety of classroom and online delivery study options to suit students’ lifestyle, aspirations and individual circumstances.

Studying at TAFE NSW offers students more than just access to outstanding teachers, state-of-the-art facilities and incredible industry connections – it also offers students a chance to experience the famous Australian lifestyle. Relax after class in world class museums or art galleries, soak up the sun on one of hundreds of beaches, or enjoy the café lifestyle that has made New South Wales one of the world’s favourite travel destinations. However students like to relax, New South Wales has them covered – and it’s all on their doorstep when they study with TAFE NSW.

Why TAFE NSW

  • Industry oriented: TAFE NSW provides industry-standard training facilities, professional teachers with real-world experience, and courses that are developed with industry partners.
  • University pathways: TAFE NSW offers a range of pathway programs that provide guaranteed entry into a number of Australian universities, including: Australian Catholic University (ACU), University of Technology Sydney (UTS), Torrens University Australia, University of Wollongong (UOW) .
  • Multiple campuses: TAFE NSW has up to 40 campuses offering CRICOS registered programs to international student in metropolitan Sydney as well as regional towns across NSW.
  • Supportive environment: TAFE NSW supports students by providing small class sizes, utilizing up-to-date teaching materials and equipment, and employing instructors with educational and industry qualifications and experience, as well as offering student’s support services.
  • Networking: TAFE NSW has a great reputation for industry and business partnerships. These relationships ensure they provide a high quality, job ready workforce to business and industry. To maintain this level of success, TAFE NSW are constantly adapting their courses and facilities to suit local community and industry needs.

universities.aboutHtml:
Teesside University generates and applies knowledge that contributes to the economic, social and cultural success of students, partners and the communities they serve. Through education enriched by research, innovation, and engagement with business and the professions, they transform lives and economies.

Teesside University is ranked in the 801-1000 band of global universities in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2020. These include almost 1,400 universities across 92 countries, standing as the largest and most diverse university rankings ever to date.

Why Teesside University

  • Campus Location: The main campus is in the heart of Middlesbrough, a friendly town with all the shops, restaurants, cinemas, pubs, clubs, sports and museums students would expect - and an art gallery and bridge that are a little more surprising.
  • Student Services: If students need advice and guidance they can find it in Student Life. The services include help on a range of issues from applications, admissions and finance to careers, disability support and counselling.
  • Facilities: Teesside has invested over £270m into their vibrant campus with facilities including: an upgraded library, specialist engineering and science labs, a new dental practice facility, state-of-the-art recording studio, and more.

universities.name: Tennessee Tech University
universities.aboutHtml:
Tennessee Tech produces practical, ready-to-work graduates from a broad range of academic disciplines prepared to compete in a technologically driven world. Students have the freedom to discover and pursue their passions, knowing there is a supportive community behind them. Developing their passions into hundreds of student clubs and organizations, Tech students make an impact on campus, in the community and around the world.

Professors and students achieve national and regional recognition for teaching and research and are responsible for Tech reputation of excellence. Tech faculty earn recognition and grants from the National Science Foundation, NASA, Oak Ridge National Laboratories and national professional societies, allowing students to study and engage in research with respected scholars in their fields of study. Tech students and faculty compete for and receive numerous Fulbright awards, and students are increasingly being chosen for national fellowships.

Tennessee Tech is committed to producing high academic achievement, fostering collaboration, and inspiring creativity and realized potential for the entire campus community. Tech students have access to multiple experiential learning opportunities in all undergraduate programs. A Tech-unique general education curriculum provides the foundation for technologically adept, analytically capable, career-ready graduates. Tech’s academic programs allow students to develop innovative, stackable credentials.

With an enrollment of more than 10,000 students, Tech offers degrees from eight academic schools and colleges: Agriculture and Human Ecology, Arts and Sciences, Business, Education, Engineering, Fine Arts and Interdisciplinary Studies.

universities.name: Texas State University
universities.aboutHtml:
Texas State University is a public, student-centered research institution guided by their unwavering belief in the power of education to transform communities, power economies, and reimagine the world. Their students come from every walk of life, from across Texas, the nation, and the world.

Texas State University is currently home to undergraduate and graduate students from more than 8- nations and offers more than 200 degree programs. Opportunities to participate fully in campus life awaits students at Texas State - including faculty-led research projects, over 330 student organizations, student support services, and more.

Why Texas State University - San Marcos

  • Campus and Residence: At 500 acres, the San Marcos Campus is big, but it’s filled with smaller places for students to discover, learn, create, and enjoy, including art galleries, maker spaces, sport fields, and a creative studio. As a freshman, students will live right on campus in one of Texas State's beautiful residence halls. Students can choose from 23 locations across campus, with 2 more opening in 2024. All are close to facilities they will need like the student center, the gymnasium, and the library.
  • Student Life: Student life Texas State is just as rich as their academics. There’s no limit to the ways students can find new experiences, meet new people, and get engaged with campus life. Get wild on an excursion with Outdoor Recreation or join friends to hear up-and-coming bands down on Cheatham Street.
  • Experiential Learning: Together, Austin, San Antonio, and San Marcos comprise the Innovation Corridor—the center of commerce, technology, and education in Texas. Internships and Optional Practical Training opportunities are abundant in Texas, and the state has one of the top-ranked economies in the nation.
  • Location: San Marcos is conveniently located between two of the largest U.S. cities, Austin and San Antonio. Austin is the place for students to explore parks, visit world-class museums, and celebrate at music, film, and food festivals. San Antonio is a historic city that’s been around since before Texas was Texas. Stroll along the famous River Walk, sample some of the best tacos in the country, or hop onto a thrilling roller coaster at one of San Antonio’s popular amusement parks.

Texas Wesleyan University was founded in 1890. It is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) to award baccalaureate, master's, and doctorate degrees.

Texas Wesleyan offers MBA degree programs with integral CPT.

Why Texas Wesleyan University

  • Curricular Practical Training: The practicum/CPT experience is an integral part of the Applied MBA programs and participation is required. CPT is authorized from day 1 for the duration of the 2-year program with no gaps or breaks.
  • Program Format: Hybrid format. Attend two-day (Saturday, and Sunday), on-campus sessions once per semester. The rest of the time students will participate in classes online via the university's learning management system. Students will take two courses per semester.

The University of Adelaide is the Preferred Pathway Provider, ensuring students are well-prepared for university. The College partners with the University to offer optimal learning opportunities, with programs designed to meet the University’s standards.

The syllabus is regularly updated with the latest university content, providing a university-level education. Why The University of Adelaide College - Adelaide

  • Facilities: Due to the College's special relationship with the University of Adelaide, students will be part of the University and have access to all the state-of-the-art facilities they have on offer, including science laboratories, the Sports Hub Fitness Centre, computer and learning facilities at Hub Central, and an extensive library of resources.
  • Flexible Options: With three intakes per year, students are sure to find a program option that works for them. Plus, with a wide variety of subjects and courses on offer, students have the chance to learn content relevant to their degree before they are even enrolled.
  • Additional English Language Support Services: The College has students from all over the world. To make sure that everyone has the best chance to reach their potential, a range of different language support services are available to assist students with their studies across subjects.

universities.name: The University of Akron (UA)
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Akron (UA), founded in 1870 as Buchtel College, is a public research university in Akron, Ohio. Serving over 15,000 students from across the U.S. and 70+ countries, UA is recognized for its strong academic programs and innovation. The University attracts students from a variety of backgrounds and geographical locations, with fall semester representation totaling 14,813 students from Ohio, around the U.S., and 70 foreign countries.

UA offers a wide variety of in-demand undergraduate and graduate programs, including many that are recognized nationally for their excellence. Located in Northeast Ohio, with easy access to Cleveland, Columbus, and Pittsburgh, near Akron Fulton Airport for convenient travel access.

Why The University of Akron (UA)

  • Global and Inclusive Environment: Top-10% ranking for international student commitment; 70 countries represented.
  • STEM and Specialized Academics: Renowned polymer engineering, corrosion engineering, and research infrastructure.
  • Scholarships: Every year, UA students receive more than $260 million in financial assistance. More than 86% of Akron's undergraduates receive some form of financial aid to lower tuition costs.
  • Comprehensive Support: Pre-arrival guidance, dedicated orientation, visa, and health system assistance.
  • On-Campus Housing Assurance: Guaranteed housing throughout academic journey.

universities.name: The University of Edinburgh
universities.aboutHtml:
Founded by the city of Edinburgh in 1583, the University of Edinburgh was the first true civic university in the UK and one of the four ancient universities of Scotland. Join some of the best students from around the globe at one of the world's top universities. Students will invest in an education that will help them build a successful future.

Join the University of Edinburgh's 13,000-strong international student community. The University of Edinburgh's flexible programmes, world-class facilities and award-winning support services combine to ensure students' university experience is exceptional and unique. The University works to support students at all stages offering welfare support, practical advice and events.

Why The University of Edinburgh

  • Location: The University is at the heart of the city of Edinburgh. Scotland’s inspiring capital is one of Europe’s great cultural hubs and a stimulating place to study. Edinburgh's dynamic cultural scene boasts the largest collection of historic buildings, museums, art galleries and theaters of any city in Scotland.
  • Clubs and Societies: The clubs and societies will help students develop their interests, meet like-minded people, indulge a hobby or simply socialize. The University of Edinburgh's host an extensive range of clubs and societies here at Edinburgh. With more than 290 to choose from, students are bound to find one that’s right for them.
  • Facilities and Services: At Edinburgh, students will get generous, flexible access to a state-of-the-art library, IT resources and study spaces, helping them fit study into their busy life. Students will have access to personal support services for all of their concerns, academic or otherwise.
  • Sport and Exercise: Edinburgh is one of the UK’s leading sports universities. Whether students are recreational gym-users or performance athletes going for gold, Edinburgh's world-class sports facilities, service and support can cater for students. The University of Edinburgh has been consistently ranked in the top 5 for sport in British Universities and Colleges Sport (BUCS) table and offer a wide range of world-class sport, fitness and performance facilities.

universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Newcastle College of International Education serves as the official on-campus pathway college to the University of Newcastle, facilitating entry to over 130 undergraduate and postgraduate degrees at a world-class institution. Its primary objective is to prepare students for success in their academic pursuits. Students enrolled at UNCIE will benefit from small class sizes and personalized support, enabling them to acquire the English language and academic skills necessary to excel at university and complete their degrees with confidence. Additionally, students will have access to the exceptional facilities and services offered by the University of Newcastle, which include seven state-of-the-art libraries housing 1.3 million resources, over 150 clubs and societies, complimentary career counseling, and a Centre for Teaching and Learning that provides drop-in sessions and academic workshops.

Why Choose the University of Newcastle College of International Education

  • Pathway to Higher Education: The University of Newcastle College of International Education provides an alternative pathway to over 130 degrees at the University of Newcastle, which was ranked among the top 200 universities globally in 2020.
  • Campus: The new campus building, situated in the heart of the city, is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities and industry-standard equipment. Students will become part of a welcoming and vibrant student community, and with ongoing support from faculty and student services staff, they will have a solid foundation to achieve their educational and career aspirations.
  • City: Newcastle is a picturesque harbor city, celebrated for its expansive sandy beaches and numerous coastal walks and bike rides, with cafes and bars located along the waterfront, all within a five-minute walk from the campus. Furthermore, accommodation in Newcastle is significantly more affordable compared to other cities across Australia.

universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Notre Dame Australia is a multi-campus university, with international campus in the historic City of Fremantle, Perth.

Notre Dame has a strong commitment to honouring the individual, and recognises that each student is graced with their own gifts and talents. Notre Dame believes that higher education should prepare students for a rich, fulfilling and reflective life, not just a career path.

Notre Dame has been rated 5 stars in the Good Universities Guide 2024, undergraduate and postgraduate categories, for Learner Engagement, Skills Development, Graduate Salary and Full-Time Employment.

Why The University of Notre Dame Australia (OIEG) - Perth?

  • Campus: The University’s Broadway Campus in perth provides a welcoming social hub in the heart of a bustling city, featuring heritage buildings and leafy courtyards. The University’s Darlinghurst Campus in perth is based in one of the most exciting and prestigious medical and research precincts in Australia.
  • History: The University of Notre Dame Australia (UNDA) in Perth, Western Australia was established in 1989 with support from the University of Notre Dame in the United States. The university's Perth campus is located in Fremantle, a historic city with well-preserved colonial streets.
  • Facility: The University of Notre Dame Australia (UNDA) has a facility in Fremantle, Perth, Australia. The facility includes the Prindiville Hall, a library, and teaching spaces.

universities.name: The University of Sheffield International College
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Sheffield International College gives you the perfect introduction to studying abroad. We teach more than 2,000 students every year, preparing them for the challenges of studying their undergraduate or postgraduate degree at a top-ranking Russell Group University.

For many international students, studying abroad brings some challenges that need a little extra support. Our international pathway programmes are delivered by Study Group and developed in collaboration with academics from the University, so you will know what to expect during your degree.

Why The University of Sheffield (StudyGroup)

  • History of excellence: Every one of its faculties is a centre of excellence and it has an outstanding track record for research and partnerships with industry. What's more, the International College has a bespoke new building, ideal for international students and central to the city. Sheffield is one of the 24 universities that make up the Russell Group. This is a collection of leading UK research universities committed to driving research and providing the very best teaching and learning experience.
  • Strong international support: Over 8,000 international students from 150 countries currently study at the University of Sheffield. It’s a place where new ideas are encouraged and nurtured. The University of Sheffield will encourage students questioning spirit and present exciting new developments in the student's chosen field.
  • Awesome on-campus facilities and extracurriculars: Students will find excellent facilities, study areas and the number 1 Students’ Union in the country. The University of Sheffield International College is located on the main campus. International College students are welcome to join in with many of the events held by the University and Students’ Union. Students can join societies, start their own clubs, or get involved in campaigning for a better future as an associate member of the Students’ Union.
  • Convenient and safe location: The University of Sheffield campus is in the heart of the city and has everything students need within walking distance. It’s a friendly, safe, multicultural city in the north of England offering plenty to see and do. Sheffield is one of the UK’s most popular places for students to go to university. The city is large enough to offer a great range of restaurants, shopping, theatre, cinemas, bars and culture; yet small enough for students to find their way around quickly and feel part of the community. Located in the county of South Yorkshire, in the north of England, Sheffield offers plenty to do both in the city and surrounding area. Students can easily travel around the UK from here too.

universities.name: The University of Tulsa (TU)
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Tulsa (TU) traces its roots to the Presbyterian School for Indian Girls, a small boarding school in Muskogee, Indian Territory, which was founded in 1882. In 1894, the Board of Home Missions of the Presbyterian Church elevated the academy’s status and chartered it as Henry Kendall College, a name that honored the first general secretary of the Home Missions Board. The first classes in the new college were held on Sept. 12, 1894.

Today, TU operates as an independent, nondenominational university. A top-rated research institution, TU welcomes students from many different faiths and countries. The TU campus fosters a rich, diverse experience for students and faculty regardless of religious or cultural background through a strong belief in mutual respect and understanding. TU students are divided among programs in five colleges: Engineering & Natural Sciences, 39%; Arts & Sciences, 21%; Business, 19%; Health Sciences, 12%; and Law, 9%. The most popular undergraduate majors are Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Biology, Nursing, Exercise & Sport Science, Psychology, Finance and Business Management.

Facing a higher education landscape with fewer students, tighter budgets and stiffer competition—during a global pandemic—The University of Tulsa in January 2021 adopted a new five-year strategic plan that sets the university on a clear path to an exciting future. The plan builds on TU’s strengths as a highly regarded, small, private research institution with deep roots in the energy industry and a hunger for innovation. It recognizes the global need for cyber leaders and charts a course for growing the talent to supply the next generation of researchers and entrepreneurs in critical fields. It proposes a level of student support that few institutions can offer. And it depends upon the recognition that all degrees—particularly those in STEM and professional disciplines—are exponentially more valuable with a firm foundation in the liberal arts.

As TU enters into implementation of this plan, they also celebrate the shared values it brings forward, including their commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion—in word and deed—and continuing to bind the future of the university to the city that shares its name. As TU succeeds, so does Tulsa.

With a population of 400,000, Tulsa, Oklahoma is an important center of commerce and industry with a thriving arts community. Tulsa’s entertainment options include professional sports, fine and performing arts, festivals, zoos, a water park, bike and hiking trails, rivers and lakes.

Tulsa boasts one of the nation’s most extensive collections of Art Deco architecture. Beyond Tulsa’s Deco District, downtown offers several other micro-districts — each with its own sense of place and things to do. From homegrown barbecue and Tex-Mex to fine French and Italian cuisine, Tulsa has restaurants to fit every taste and budget. Fresh sushi, independent coffee shops and vegan delicacies line Brookside while food trucks are a staple around Guthrie Green. From food to fashion, Tulsa offers a multitude of shopping experiences. Explore eclectic boutiques and pop-up shops near campus and downtown. Woodland Hills Mall is more than 1 million square feet of retail heaven with 165-plus stores. Tulsa also has a rich local music history, literally pioneering genres from western swing in the 1930s to the ‘Tulsa Sound’ in the 1970s to pop and alternative music today. Today, Tulsa has outstanding venues to hear live music.

Why the University of Tulsa?

  • Research Opportunities: Tulsa Undergraduate Research Challenge involves the University of Tulsa’s youngest students in advanced research opportunities and faculty mentorship.
  • Renowned for STEM: The University of Tulsa’s College of Engineering and Natural Sciences has been ranked among the top 25 STEM Colleges by Forbes America’s Best Colleges.
  • Challenge Conventions: Oklahoma Center for the Humanities at the University of Tulsa promotes critical thought, ethical inquiry, bold imagination and respect for the diversity of human experience.
  • Education for the Digital Age: The University of Tulsa’s Tandy School of Computer Science is recognized as a designated Center of Academic Excellence in Information Assurance, Cyber Defense Education, AI Research and Cyber Operations.
  • Recreation and Exercise: The University of Tulsa’s 200+ acre campus offers ample green spaces for autumn strolls, winter snowmen or springtime soccer; students can also exercise and play sports in the Collins Fitness Center, or cheer for 17 Golden Hurricane Division One intercollegiate teams.

universities.name: Thompson Rivers University (TRU)
universities.aboutHtml:
Thompson Rivers University's priority is student success. They empower their students to reach their goals with flexible learning options, individualized student services, hands-on learning opportunities, and a diverse, inclusive environment. For 45 years TRU has taken pride in providing an excellent education to every student that comes to them—from a wide variety of backgrounds and perspectives, at various stages of the learning journey. From traditional academics to trades, from certificates to graduate degrees.

TRU offers over 140 on-campus programs. TRU students apply what they learn in co-op work terms, study abroad, undergraduate research, field schools and practicums, service learning and other opportunities — with guidance and mentorship by our accessible faculty. Research, creation and innovation thrive in our open, flexible learning environment, as do TRU students.

Students will find the perfect balance of arts, culture, adventure, and academics. at Thompson Rivers University, located in beautiful Kamloops, British Columbia, 3.5 hours from Vancouver. A major centre in its own right, students will enjoy the community feeling of Kamloops, while still savouring the amenities and attractions of a large, bustling city.

Why Thompson Rivers University

  • Location: Kamloops has both a tightknit community feel and the amenities and attractions of a large, bustling centre. Beyond the campus students will find beautiful beaches and parks lining the junction of two rivers next to a vibrant downtown. Study and play in one's own backyard with natural features like hiking trails, cycling paths, lakes and the nearby award-winning Sun Peaks ski resort.
  • Arts and Culture: Students can feed their artistic appetite in the front row of touring big-name bands or in smaller venues with local musicians. They can immerse themselves in work by prominent Canadian and international artists at the local art gallery. They can catch a thought-provoking independent film, or box office hit at one of the cinemas. Kamloops presents opportunities to join an inclusive and welcoming community with Kamloops Pride or relax, visit and chill out in one of the many locally-owned, eclectic cafés.
  • Opportunities: The choices here are limitless. There is a law school, a business school and a nursing school. TRU has options in trades, technology and engineering. They can prepare students for medical school. They offer theatre, visual arts, journalism and liberal arts. They can teach students how to be a chef, or operate a ski hill, or become a social worker, or a teacher. If students aren’t sure where to begin, there are plenty of support resources to get them started.
  • Small Class Sizes and Student Support: Between program advisors, counsellors, future students, awards and financial support, TRU has got students covered for any questions they have. In small classes and a tight-knit campus community, passionate professors will support and inspire students to think, interact, research, learn and engage with diverse people whether they are from Kamloops, Canada, or around the world.

universities.name: Tiffin University
universities.aboutHtml:
Tiffin University was established in 1888 and now offers nationally accredited graduate and undergraduate degrees in Business Administration, top-notch bachelor’s and master’s degrees in Criminal Justice and Social Sciences, and distinctive degrees in the Arts and Sciences. All through school's history, the University has nurtured a student-centered setting and a strong sense of real community for students, faculty and staff. Tiffin University has always believed in offering the highest quality education – “an education for life.”

Why Tiffin University

  • Campus Life: The main campus in Tiffin is a beautiful 153-acre blend of traditional historic and modern buildings that create a vibrant and warm home for an educational community. In addition to the growth in Tiffin, TU graduate and undergraduate programs are offered online. The Bachelor of Business Administration and MBA programs are also offered at Bucharest, Romania. The American Institute of Applied Sciences in Switzerland (AUS) and TU have entered into a partnership, the Dual Degree Program (DDP), allowing AUS students to obtain a dual degree from both institutions.
  • Vision: A lifelong learning community at Tiffin University for the intellectual enrichment and stimulation of adults 50 years and older.
  • Mission: Establish a community of lifelong learners, age 50 plus, by offering member-driven topics of interest that promote learning and enriching experiences through unique programs and ongoing community-University engagement.

universities.name: Toronto Metropolitan University
universities.aboutHtml:
Toronto Metropolitan University is located in the heart of Toronto, Canada, the fourth largest city in North America. At Toronto Metropolitan, students can connect with leaders in culture, business, health care or government because opportunities are abundant. That's the advantage that students receive while studying in Toronto. Toronto Metropolitan University is dedicated to creating a culture of action. The University strongly believes that education and experience go hand-in-hand. What students learn in the classroom is enhanced by real-world knowledge through internships and co-ops, or amplified through zone learning, specialized minors and graduate programs.

Why Toronto Metropolitan University

  • Location: Toronto Metropolitan University is located in the heart of downtown Toronto, not far from Kensington Market, the Royal Ontario Museum, the Eaton Centre, and many other popular attractions.
  • Physical Wellness: There are many ways to stay fit on campus. Students can enjoy various group fitness classes (such as dance or spin), join intramural sports or attend instructional classes.
  • Facilities: The Recreation and Athletic Centre (RAC) is fully equipped with a fitness centre, two gyms, a track, squash courts, and much more.
  • Additional Learning Opportunities: Zone Learning is a new experiential program. Similar to a co-op program, Zone Learning allows students to apply the knowledge and skills they acquired in class to resolve real world problems at/for various start-ups, projects and ventures.

Application Fee Notice: Please be aware that the application fees are subject to change depending on program level, portal used, previous post-secondary education, and number of OUAC applications.

universities.aboutHtml:
Toronto Metropolitan University International College (TMUIC), formerly Ryerson University International College (RUIC), is a distinctly urban university driven to apply their knowledge to improve lives in Toronto and across the globe. From their commitment to experience-based learning to our entrepreneurial spirit to their deeply creative culture, innovation defines all that they do. TMUIC thinks differently about what’s possible and invite their students to do the same.

Why Toronto Metropolitan University International College

  • Campus: Live in Canada’s largest city and gain access to diverse industries and employment opportunities while enjoying world-class food, the arts and culture.
  • Facilities: Enjoy state-of-the-art accommodations with a 24-hour fitness centre, dramatic study & lounge spaces, and an active social calendar – all in a perfect location in the heart of the city.
  • Culture/city/location: Toronto Metropolitan University is in the heart of downtown Toronto, Canada's largest city. A dynamic centre of business, industry and culture, the city is friendly and accessible, and the citizens - like Toronto Metropolitan's students - come from all over the world.

Note: To be eligible to a PGWP, students must successfully finish the selected program at Toronto Metropolitan University.

universities.name: Trent University
universities.aboutHtml:
Consistently recognized nationally for leadership in teaching, research and student satisfaction, Trent attracts excellent students from across the country and around the world. Across all disciplines, Trent brings critical, integrative thinking to life every day. Trent's unique approach to personal development through supportive, collaborative community engagement is in more demand than ever. Students lead the way by co-creating experiences rooted in dialogue, diverse perspectives and collaboration.

Just 90 minutes from downtown Toronto, Trent’s Peterborough Campus offers an impressive range of academically rigorous programs across the arts and sciences, as well as professional programs in business, law, medicine, the environment and more. This is where academic excellence combines with state-of-the-art research facilities.

Why Trent University - Peterborough

  • Campus Life and Surroundings: The City of Peterborough blends a thriving arts, culture, and entertainment scene with the breathtaking natural landscapes of the famed Kawartha Lakes region. This relaxed and friendly community offers the perfect backdrop for students who want both an ideal place to study and a chance to make lasting memories with new friends at the city’s trendy restaurants, cafés, pubs, and festivals. Whether a nature lover, adventure seeker, foodie, or all of the above, Peterborough is a wonderful place to live, study, and gain valuable work experience
  • Supportive Environment: At Trent University, students can benefit from a vibrant student life, a diverse student body, personal attention from faculty and experiential learning opportunities.
  • Many Options: Trent University offers over 100 programs across its two campuses. This means that at Trent, students don’t have to choose between programs and passions. The flexible degree options allow them to do both.
  • Real-World Experience: Valuable real-world experience is at students' fingertips at Trent – through experimental learning and hands-on research, students will work side-by-side with leading faculty on research projects on campus, in the community, and around the world.

universities.aboutHtml:
For more than 130 years, Trine University has prepared students like you to lead, succeed and serve. You’ll find excellence in academic programs that offer hands-on experience with real-world projects, in expert faculty mentors who will take the time to care about your education and life goals, in state-of-the-art facilities, and in alumni who impact their communities, nation and world. Our high standards are consistently recognized by publications like U.S. News & World Report and Princeton Review.

There’s a time and place for thinking and doing. We make both happen at Trine University. Founded in 1884, we’re known for our rigorous academic programs, exceptional faculty, and hands-on experiences that lead to real-world, skill-based knowledge.

Why Trine University

Trine University promotes intellectual and personal development through professionally focused and formative learning opportunities, preparing students to succeed, lead and serve. The vision of Trine University is that we will be recognized as a premier private university, characterized as engaged, dynamic, growing and adding value.

To achieve our mission, undergraduate and graduate students receive personal attention through small classes and excellent teaching. At Trine, we focus on your future by providing career-oriented higher education that emphasizes:

  • Active participation in classes, with a focus on teaming and collaboration
  • The useful and practical, to complement rigorous theoretical study.
  • Intentional co-curricular experiences to cultivate holistic student development
  • Learning how to do, while learning what to do

universities.name: Trinity Western University
universities.aboutHtml:
Trinity Western University (TWU) is a Christian University of the arts, sciences, and professions, legislated by British Columbia to serve the public. Recognized for quality, TWU is consistently ranked among the top two universities in Canada for Educational Experience by the National Survey of Student Engagement; holds three Canada Research Chairs; wins National Championships in CIS sports; and emphasizes experiential learning to prepare graduates to make a global impact. TWU offers 42 bachelor’s degrees, 16 graduate degrees, and adult degree-completion programs. A vibrant community committed to educating the whole person, TWU has been developing leaders of character and competence for 50 years.

Trinity Western University's mission, as an arm of the Church, is to develop godly Christian leaders: positive, goal-oriented university graduates with thoroughly Christian minds; growing disciples of Jesus Christ who glorify God through fulfilling the Great Commission, serving God and people in the various marketplaces of life.

Why Trinity Western University

  • Campus: Trinity Western University welcomes students from around the world. Students can choose from a wide variety of programs and experience a high quality of education in a friendly and safe campus environment.
  • Facilities: The University has countless health and wellness facilities and services to take advantage of, including a gym, fitness studio and centre, personal training, a bouldering wall and three outdoor fields.
  • Mental Health Services: At Trinity Western University, students' mental is taken seriously. There are many self-help and counselling resources available on-campus and online.
  • Athletics: Students can join the Spartans varsity teams or participate in fun recreational activities and intramurals such as soccer, volleyball, basketball, multisport and flag football.

universities.name: Troy University
universities.aboutHtml:
Troy University, based in Alabama, is a public university founded in 1887. Through a network of locations and a robust online offering, TROY serves both traditional students and adult learners with a worldwide enrollment of more than 20,000 TROY operates four campuses in Alabama--Troy, Dothan, Montgomery and Phenix City-and locations in 7 states, in both Japan and Korea and partnerships with universities in China, Vietnam and Malaysia.

Founded as a college to train teachers, Troy University has today grown into a thriving international university that enrolls more than 1,000 international students, representing more than 76 countries. Also highlighting the University's international focus, TROY is home to Alabama's only Confucius Institute that maintains a statewide mission of educating about the Chinese language, culture and history and forging economic development ties between the state and China.

The complete university experience may be found at Troy University’s beautiful, historic campus in Troy, Ala. The Troy, Ala. campus provides top-notch academic programs as well as experiences that shape careers and lives. Students on the Troy Campus enjoy more than 200 clubs, Greek organizations and philanthropic groups, as well study abroad programs, Division I athletics, an honors program and more.

The Troy Campus also offers a wide variety of residence halls, including apartment style units. The surrounding city of Troy is a charming Southern city with a picturesque town square featuring unique boutiques and food options.

Why Troy University

  • For over 130 years, Troy University has enabled and encouraged its students to define who they are and find their place in the world. Troy accomplishes its mission through diversity, dedication, and making a difference. This is through the Trojan Warrior Spirit.
  • Campus life: Located in the warm Southeastern part of the U.S., within easy drive to Florida and the city of Atlanta. We offer quality education at an exceptional value.
  • Hands-on experience: With more than 100 undergraduate and graduate majors and programs, Troy University gives you ample opportunities to explore all of your academic options. Troy University offers degree programs in high-demand fields across its five colleges--the College of Arts and Sciences; the Sorrell College of Business; the College of Communication and Fine Arts; the College of Education; and, the College of Health and Human Services.
  • Facilities: Troy University has been on the forefront of internationalization for the past 50 years. Students from more than one hundred countries have been part of shaping tolerance and an exceptional diverse cultural on our Alabama campuses and international sites.
  • Enhanced learning experience: Troy gives you the best of both worlds. On one side it has the friendly feel, small classes with personalized attention. On the other hand, Troy offers the amenities of a large university, including NCAA division 1 athletics and a large variety of social and extra-curricular activities. The result is high value and lower than average cost.

universities.name: Tulane University
universities.aboutHtml:
Non sibi, sed suis - "not for one's self, but for one's own."

Located in a city with vibrant neighborhoods, and world-renowned live music, Tulane University has become one of the most well-respected universities in the country. Starting as a medical college, Tulane University has been providing education since 1834 and now offers a wide variety of programs and services to its student population.

Tulane University pushes for excellence from its students, being a part of the prestigious Association of American Universities, and is ranked by the Carnegie Foundation as a university with “very high research activity”. Steeped in traditions, and creating a culture of community, Tulane University is a powerful choice in education.

Why Tulane University

  • Research: Tulane University’s claim to fame is its research. Taught by world-class faculty, students are well set-up for their education. As well, the University is small, and with an average of 21 students per class, students will have access to those educators and benefit from their knowledge.
  • Campus Life: Tulane University has a beautiful campus that has all the amenities to set students up for success. There are several options for residence, and dining for students to choose from, setting students up for success.
  • Culture: With over 200 student organizations, and a rich culture in the city surrounding the school, Tulane has a strong identity and a history of traditions. Students are encouraged to participate in the activities on campus, and the city, in order to give back.
  • Location: The University is located in New Orleans, with beautiful parks, and unique neighborhoods. The city is filled with famous restaurants and students can visit many well-known spots such as Café du Monde. They can visit the French Quarter, and listen to music, or they can join a haunted history tour. No matter what they're interested in, students will find something that endears the city to them.

Located in Toronto, Tyndale University has been training Christian leaders since 1894 and offers a wide range of programs at the undergraduate, seminary and graduate levels. Tyndale Seminary is Canada’s largest seminary and is located in Toronto — Canada’s largest city. Tyndale Seminary encourages its students to embrace a holistic approach to their education by putting into practice what they learn and faculty embrace the same approach.

Tyndale University is dedicated to the pursuit of truth, to excellence in teaching, learning and research, for the enriching of mind, heart and character, to serve the church and the world for the glory of God.

Why Tyndale?

  • Fully Accredited Programs: Tyndale University is accredited by the Ontario Ministry of Training, Colleges and Universities and the Association of Theological Schools.
  • Diversity: Students at Tyndale represent 60 ethnic backgrounds and 40 different Christian denominations. Diverse faculty have studied and taught around the world, bringing the perspective of global Christian ministry into the classroom
  • Canada’s Largest Seminary: Tyndale University is Canada’s largest seminary, their size allows them to provide a wide-ranging education.
  • The Centre for Academic Excellence: The Centre offers free services that will give students practical tools to achieve their potential. Students of all abilities have benefitted from personal academic advising, writing workshops and seminars offered.

Ulster University - Birmingham is best known for its excellence in research, particularly in fields like biomedical sciences, social sciences, and engineering. The university is also recognised for its strong industry connections, employability-focused programmes, and extensive student support services

The Birmingham campus offer undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in business and computing subjects in professional learning environments. Their focus is to ensure graduates don’t just have a degree, but are highly employable and motivated individuals ready to function in a dynamic business environment.

Why Ulster University - Birmingham

  • Campus Life: Ideally campus located near many popular cafes, Birmingham campus can be found right in the heart of the city, close to key transport links, cafes, shopping centres and museums.
  • Facilities: School offers a variety of modern facilities, including: Libraries with extensive digital and physical resources.

universities.name: Universal Higher Education
universities.aboutHtml:
Universal Higher Education UK (UHE UK) is a London-based higher education study centre operated as part of the Oxford International Education Group network. UHE UK delivers undergraduate and postgraduate higher education programmes in partnership with established UK universities, including the University of Roehampton and the University of Bradford. Its programmes are designed to provide students with recognised UK qualifications alongside a supportive, career-focused learning experience.

UHE UK has a diverse international student community and focuses on accessible teaching, small class sizes and personalised academic support. Students can benefit from guidance from tutors and student-support staff throughout their studies, helping them build academic knowledge, confidence and career-ready skills.

Why Universal Higher Education UK?

  • Supportive Learning Environment:UHE UK focuses on a student-centred learning experience with small class sizes and accessible tutors. Academic and student-support teams help students settle into their studies, remain engaged and make progress towards their academic goals.
  • International Student Community: UHE UK welcomes students from around the world, creating a multicultural learning environment where students can interact with people from different countries and backgrounds. The institution highlights its international community as an important part of the student experience.
  • Recognised UK University Partnerships: UHE UK delivers programmes in partnership with established UK universities. Undergraduate programmes are designed and awarded by the University of Roehampton, while postgraduate programmes are designed and awarded by the University of Bradford.

universities.name: University Canada West (UCW)
universities.aboutHtml:
University Canada West (UCW) is a contemporary independent university located in the heart of vibrant Vancouver. Established in 2004, UCW offers a range of career-focused programs including the Bachelor of Commerce, Bachelor of Arts in Business Communication and Master of Business Administration. UCW is an innovative business and technology-oriented, teaching-focused institution in Canada, offering undergraduate and graduate degrees for domestic and international students. The university is a dynamic and growing institution defined by its close connections to the business community and by a commitment to outstanding student services.

UCW students come from more than 90 countries around the world and include Canadian citizens, permanent residents and visiting students who contribute to the diversity and richness of the university. Regardless of whether they are a recent high-school graduate, a college or university graduate, a transfer student, or a working professional, students will find what they need at UCW.

Why University Canada West

  • Campus Life: UCW is situated in the heart of Vancouver in the historic London Building. The university is easily accessible by transit and students will feel right at home surrounded by coffee shops, restaurants, entertainment, shopping centres and gym facilities. Many of the world’s biggest companies have offices within walking distance of the downtown campus, providing students with unparalleled access to a network of prospective employers.
  • Experienced Faculty: UCW's professors are not just esteemed academics, they also have the added bonus of industry experience so they don’t just repeat textbook content. Throughout their programs, students' professors will use their years of professional experience to equip them with the latest knowledge and skills needed to succeed in today’s competitive global marketplace.
  • Small Class Sizes: UCW’s learning environment will appeal to many. Classes are kept small, so students can enjoy high levels of interaction with classmates and benefit from undivided attention from their professors.
  • Faster Program Completion: Programs are delivered over four terms per year, which can reduce the time students spend in school before landing their dream jobs.

Note: The application fee is $150.00 CAD (for countries: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Cameroon, Gambia, Mongolia, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Syria, Uganda).

universities.name: University at Buffalo, State University of New York
universities.aboutHtml:
The University at Buffalo (UB) is the largest and most comprehensive university in the State University of New York (SUNY) system, a New York State flagship university, and a longstanding member of the prestigious Association of American Universities.

UB enrolls over 30,000 students and spans 13 schools and colleges. From biotechnology and semiconductors to international economics and psychology, UB is a place where students can make a real impact.

University at Buffalo's breakthroughs result in new cures, advanced materials, and resilient communities, and 100% of the University's students have the opportunity to get involved in research. UB students live and learn across three distinct yet complementary campuses: North Campus, located in a vibrant suburban area; South Campus, set in a historic urban neighborhood; and Downtown Campus, situated in Buffalo's dynamic medical corridor.

Why study at the University at Buffalo?

  • Diverse Program Offerings. With over 140 majors and 70 combined degree programs, the largest range of undergraduate programs in SUNY, UB has a program to match every interest and any future students envision. For students who are not sure what to study, UB also offers an exploratory major to help them discover their strengths and find their passion.
  • UB is the perfect size. At UB, students will experience two important benefits: the extensive resources of a major public research university and the advantages of personalized learning.
  • UB's 12:1 student-to-faculty ratio ensures small classes and personalized attention from leading experts in any field. This unique environment combines modern facilities with a supportive learning community, all within a diverse, global campus. For students seeking a world-class education that offers both broad opportunities and individual support, UB is an ideal choice.
  • UB is home to Empire AI. Empire AI is a $400M investment that brings New York State's public and private universities together to advance artificial intelligence, with UB leading the charge. It will establish a state-of-the-art AI computing center at UB and position UB students and graduates at the forefront of the AI revolution.
  • UB is an excellent investment. UB is consistently recognized as one of the world’s most exceptional and affordable universities, making it a top choice for students and faculty around the globe. Scholarships are also available to first-year international undergraduates, ensuring a UB education is within reach of students from all backgrounds.
  • Life at UB is fun! UB has over 400 student clubs and organizations, Division I athletics, nine theater and performance venues, not to mention an eSports arena and a 60-acre recreational lake. There's always something fun to do at UB, and new friends to do it with.
  • Everyone is welcome at UB. UB has a diverse and welcoming international community with dedicated services and support for international students. UB has a long history of supporting international students, having been among the top 30 U.S. institutions for hosting international students for over 20 years. The City of Buffalo (also known as the City of Good Neighbors) is a thriving border city in a region of more than two million people from various countries and backgrounds. No matter their race, religion, or country of birth, there is a place for all students at UB.

universities.accommodationHtml:
On-Campus Housing

To learn about on-campus housing, visit the Choose Campus Living webpage. See a summary of available housing below.

  • Residence Halls: Outdoor fire pits. Environmentally friendly housing. Dining options voted the best in the nation. Residence halls designed by I.M. Pei and Associates. Students will find all of this—and so much more—only at UB’s official on-campus housing. It’s easy to enjoy everything that UB has to offer when students live right here.
  • On-Campus Apartments: The comfort of an apartment. The convenience of campus life. At UB, students can have it all, with furnished apartments that let them be independent and still be part of the UB community. All UB apartments are on North Campus (or right across the street), giving students easy access to classes, labs, concerts and more.

Application Information for New Students

New UB students have the opportunity to submit their housing application including the $300 housing deposit after they have paid their tuition deposit until spaces are unavailable.

All students who complete a housing application and submit a deposit are eligible for on-campus housing for the upcoming year based on availability of spaces. To learn more about the application information, see the Applying for Housing webpage.

Off-Campus Housing

University at Buffalo has curated helpful information that will help students interested in living off-campus. See the Off-Campus Housing webpage.

universities.name: University of Aberdeen International Study Centre
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Aberdeen International Study Centre is located at the heart of the historic King’s College Campus. It offers a full range of subject options and pathways, including tailored programs in engineering and medical studies.

The UK’s fifth oldest university, Aberdeen has been offering life-changing learning opportunities for more than 500 years. Today, it adds to this rich heritage with modern facilities and a 21st-century outlook. Represented by 130 nationalities, the University has an international community and is committed to equality and diversity.

The University of Aberdeen strives to be one of the world’s top research-intensive universities. Associated with five Nobel Prize winners, it is known for learning and research excellence. Students at Aberdeen benefit from a personalized experience and flexible learning. Honours students receive a broad and flexible education within the Scottish four-year degree system.

Why the University of Aberdeen

  • History: Aberdeen is among the UKs ancient univiersities, with a founding date in 1495.
  • Campus: Aberdeen boasts impressive facilities both inside and outside of the classroom - and features a blend of historic and modern buildings.
  • Facilities: Students will benefit from access to world class facilities including the Sir Duncan Rice Library, and Aberdeen Sports Village.
  • Culture: With students from more than 130 nations represented on campus, the University of Aberdeen boasts a strong multicultural community, and international students will benefit from both the international community as well as Scotland's own distinct culture.

universities.name: University of Birmingham
universities.aboutHtml:
From 1900 to the present day, the University of Birmingham has been at the forefront of both national and international research, leading the way in making ground-breaking progress in areas that span industries such as gene structure, medicine, space research and communications. For more than a century, the University of Birmingham has been pursuing and sharing knowledge through outstanding teaching and world-leading research. A global reputation, quality learning and teaching, excellent facilities, a stunning campus and great city are some of the reasons making the University of Birmingham a great place to study and live.

The University of Birmingham is the original ‘redbrick’ University, part of the prestigious Russell Group; their thriving student population enjoys a wide range of courses, and exceptional campus and research facilities. Their heritage as the original ‘redbrick’ is combined with one of the most compelling and ambitious agendas in higher education. The University of Birmingham has been transformed in recent years, characterised by major investments in academic staffing, investment of £1 billion in campus facilities, strong and improving outcomes for their students, annual growth in research performance, and bold new moves.

The 10 Nobel Laureates the University of Birmingham counts among their staff and alumni have contributed to some of science’s greatest discoveries, including in recent times the Higgs Boson and Gravitational Waves. The University of Birmingham's research provides innovative solutions to the challenges faced in their city, their region and across the globe.

As one of the most popular UK universities, offering diverse opportunities for study and research, the University of Birmingham encourages and empowers people to turn ideas into reality and make important things happen.

Why the University of Birmingham

  • Green and Spacious Campus: Students will discover themselves at a green and spacious campus university just minutes from the hustle and bustle of the UK's diverse and vibrant second city. The eyes of the world will be on Birmingham in 2022 when they host the Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games.
  • Campus Facilities: The University of Birmingham's physical estate is the largest single enabler for world-class teaching and research, and provides a fantastic student experience, covering 672 acres, with over 200 buildings of different ages, complexities, physical condition and use, ranging from grade one and two listed properties to brand new state-of-the-art learning and research spaces.
  • Centre of Culture: From museums to the blue plaque trail, the campus is brimming with things to do and learn about.

universities.name: University of Bradford
universities.aboutHtml:
Study at the University of Bradford to benefit from - and be part of - teaching and research that harnesses technology for the good of society. At the University of Bradford, students will learn from academic and industry experts who are shaping the future of their sectors, and they'll learn in world-class facilities - they’ve invested millions of pounds in high-tech learning environments, such as their motion capture studio and Bloomberg Trading Room. Many of the courses at the University of Bradford have professional, statutory or regulatory body accreditation or approval, giving students the best possible start to their career.

Students will find a diverse mix of people from different backgrounds, faiths, nationalities and ages all sharing the close-knit City Campus at the University of Bradford. The Times and Sunday Times have named the University of Bradford as the UK’s University of the Year for Social Inclusion 2020. This prestigious national award recognises Bradford’s outstanding impact on social inclusion that ensures all students, irrespective of their background, are supported to achieve their potential and go on to achieve success.

Why the University of Bradford

  • A Sustainable City Centre Campus: Students will find everything they need on City Campus. City Campus is compact, self contained, and located just minutes from the city centre. Not only is the campus central it’s sustainable. With buildings made from hemp, beehives with student beekeepers, and edible gardens, sustainable development is embedded in University life. The University of Bradford regularly wins awards for their environmental initiatives, and their new developments are amongst the most sustainable buildings of their kind. Their campus is ranked the 4th greenest in the world.
  • Accommodation: The Green is the accommodation recommended by the University of Bradford to their students. The Green is just a few minutes from the Students' Union, the library and morning lectures. It is also just a short walk away from the city centre and other local attractions. The Site Team and their Student Wardens organise social events, trips, competitions and games on and off site – so students will have plenty of opportunities to meet new people and make lots of friends. The apartments also cater for people with a wide range of disabilities
  • Arts and Culture: Bradford’s thriving arts scene, diverse multicultural influences and historic venues make it an exciting cultural centre. The University has its own theatre, gallery and music centre. They run an Arts on Campus programme which offers something for everyone, with regular film screenings, exhibitions, talks and events. There are also many student-led societies and clubs covering all kinds of cultural interests.
  • Sports and Fitness: Bradford is a really sporty city. The Team Bradford sporting community offers clubs and activities for every student. Students can get involved in a range of sports; from football to snowboarding, archery to athletics. They have fantastic sports facilities on campus including Unique Fitness and Lifestyle, which offers a swimming pool, a climbing wall, a fully equipped gym, regular classes and therapy sessions, and a multi-use sports hall.
  • Career and Employability Services: The University of Bradford’s Career and Employability Services offers comprehensive support for students in developing employability skills, finding placements, part-time jobs and graduate employment. This support doesn’t end at graduate, the University offers continued support for five years after graduation

universities.name: University of Bradford International College
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Bradford International College (UBIC) is an embedded college located in the centre of the University of Bradford in West Yorkshire, England. UBIC offers pathway programmes for international students to prepare them for undergraduate and postgraduate studies in the UK.

The pathway programmes offer students various routes to a degree. Depending on level of study, English language ability, and subject area, the first stages at Bradford may be through the following pathways:

  1. International Foundation Year (IFY)
  2. International Year Zero (IYZ)
  3. International Year One (IY1)
  4. International Incorporated Masters (IIM)

Why University of Bradford International College

  • Enhancing English skills: By studying at UBIC, students will improve their academic and English language skills. They will be prepared for their future studies at the University of Bradford, a top 25 UK university for graduate prospects (The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide, 2019).
  • Diverse community: UBIC was awarded the Queen's anniversary prize for higher and further education, continually providing high-quality academic teaching with industry expertise to a global community of over 130 different nationalities.
  • Research and teaching quality: University of Bradford is a technology with over 50 years of innovation and excellence. The university is a part of the World Technology Universities Network, and is silver rated in the Teaching Excellence Framework.

universities.name: University of Bridgeport
universities.aboutHtml:
With a vibrant, globally diverse campus, the University of Bridgeport welcomes students from over 80 countries to take advantage of its uniquely career-oriented degree programs.

The University promotes academic excellence, personal responsibility, and commitment to service. Distinctive curricula in an international, culturally diverse supportive learning environment prepare graduates for life and leadership in an increasingly interconnected world.

Campus Life:

  • University of Bridgeport's 56-acre main campus is situated on a gorgeous stretch of Long Island Sound in Bridgeport, Conn., provides an ideal setting for scholarly pursuits. The campus is home to 14 schools, colleges and institutes, 7 residence halls, 4 dining facilities, a bookstore, snack shop, and a student center equipped with pool tables, a café and computer lab, student lounges, and clubs and activities spaces. All of the University’s academic offerings are available through the main Bridgeport campus. This includes over 125 degree programs, minors, concentrations, and certificates.
  • The University of Bridgeport’s Waterbury Center offers graduate programs in Education and accelerated degree completion programs in Human Services, Psychology and General Studies. The Waterbury Center is conveniently located near Interstate-84 in a modern office park near the Cheshire town line.
  • Living on campus is an important part of the overall experience and development of students at the University. University of Bridgeport's residence halls are not just places for students to sleep, but are vibrant communities where students are ENGAGED as active members of the campus, EDUCATED on topics directly related to their success and EMPOWERED with the critical thinking skills that will help in their transformation into a responsible and active member of a global community.
  • University of Bridgeport's students are career prepared. UB's

Student Experience:

  • From day one, all first-year students are paired with an academic advisor to help them build their first semester around a learning community with three classes and a group of 20 students. Upper-class students serve as peer mentors, and classes are taught by excellent faculty, including the president and provost.
  • The Honors Program at University of Bridgeport provides a dynamic, challenging, and supportive environment for highly motivated students. Students will emerge confident, professional, and prepared for wherever their paths may lead. University of Bridgeport honors students receive benefits and experiences that enhance their college journey. The Honors Program is built around four core areas, Community Building, Personal & Professional Development, Service and Cultural Exploration. Aside from exciting events, honors students receive early course registration, access to an Honors Lounge, and recognition upon graduation.

Student Support:

  • Academic Support Services offers tutoring, group study sessions, study-skills workshops, and other valuable services to ensure student success.
  • The University of Bridgeport Student Health Services offers high quality, student health care for the treatment of acute illnesses and injuries. Serious medical problems are referred to the local hospital emergency room. A medical director, nurse practitioners, and nurses staff the center.
  • Counselling Services offers a private and confidential atmosphere for students to sort out their personal worries and concerns about college life or life in general.

Accreditation: The University of Bridgeport is accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education. The University also is accredited by the Connecticut Office of Higher Education.

universities.name: University of Brighton
universities.aboutHtml:
University of Brighton is a progressive, modern school in one of Britain's most exciting, lively cities. It is career-focused with excellent facilities and business connections and, at its heart, it is an inventive institution with a creative spirit. The university offers degrees in a variety of subjects and its main campus, Moulsecoomb, is home to programs in applied sciences, architecture, business, law, and engineering. Over the last few years, this inspiring campus has undergone a significant transformation, and now features new residence halls and learning facilities, fitness and student union facilities, numerous green spaces, and an accessible pedestrian bridge that links both sides of campus.

A big part of the academic culture at University of Brighton is about unlocking each student's potential by empowering them to do something they really love and succeed at it. Degrees at Brighton are generally quite flexible, and students are often can choose optional modules, work placements and volunteering opportunities that work to their strengths.

Why University of Brighton?

  • Campus: Brighton's community is made up of students and staff from over 150 countries. There are more than 100 societies for students to expand their interests, meet like-minded people, and do something they love.
  • Facilities: The university has 4 campuses, all with superb facilities, including sports halls, a swimming pool, dance studios, a newsroom, Psychology labs, world-class Design Archives, and more!
  • Location: Brighton is a student-friendly, artistic, and bustling city with famous beaches and a diverse and inclusive community. It has an abundance of stores, green spaces, restaurants, bars, and entertainment options, and is a short train ride from London.
  • Placement Opportunities: An important part of many programs at Brighton is the opportunity for students to gain work or volunteer experience in a professional environment.
  • Professional Accreditation: The majority of students study programs that are accredited by professional and statutory bodies. Successful completion of a professionally accredited course indicates that the student has reached the occupational standard required to practice that profession.

universities.name: University of Buckingham
universities.aboutHtml:
The University of Buckingham combines academic excellence with independence in a supportive, student-focused environment. Founded on academic freedom, it nurtures a diverse international community, encouraging critical thinking through small-group tutorials instead of large lectures. Buckingham offers flexible pathways, including September and January starts, two-year undergraduate degrees, and 4.5-year Medicine programs, enabling faster graduation for postgraduate study or workforce entry. Since launching the UK’s first two-year degrees in 1983, it has refined its programs to provide the widest range of accelerated degrees in the country.

Ranked 1st for Lecturer and Teaching Quality and Student Support in Southeast England (WUSCAs 2025), Buckingham reflects a commitment to high-quality teaching and personalized care. Guided by a vision of academic freedom and a mission to inspire individuals through learning, research, and entrepreneurship, Buckingham equips students to become future leaders and innovators.

  • Two-Year Bachelor’s Degree: Innovative two-year programmes add an additional summer term, allowing students to complete the same teaching weeks as a traditional three-year degree without increased workload. Students can progress directly to a master’s programme, completing both degrees in three years.
  • Save Time and Money: The fast-tracked schedule enables students to graduate and enter the workforce up to a year earlier than at most universities, offering savings of around 20% compared to traditional courses.
  • Small Group Teaching: With smaller class sizes, students receive individual attention from personal tutors. Academics integrate their latest research into teaching, ensuring students graduate with current, industry-relevant knowledge. With about 2,700 students, the University fosters a close-knit environment.
  • Culture: Buckingham has a diverse community with students from over 100 nationalities, resembling a global village where cross-cultural connections thrive.
  • Values: Defined by independence and a distinctive ethos, Buckingham continues to uphold the principle of independent thinking established by its founders.
  • Location: Set in a picturesque riverside campus, the University is near a vibrant market town with easy access to shops, cafés, and excellent transport links, including Milton Keynes train station for fast connections to major cities. Students can join various clubs and societies catering to diverse interests.
